title: Ziv haptic timing — the single source for the phone feel-tool and the haptic_out firmware
rule: One beat = buzz for buzz_ms, then silence for gap_after_ms. Braille cell buzz = cell_base_ms + cell_per_dot_ms * dot_count.

ui.note: Feel-tool page affordances only — the band fires patterns immediately, does not loop them, and tunes cell gap in its own config within the same envelope. spell_max_letters caps the page's spell box; the firmware accepts up to 16 (HAPTIC_OUT_MAX_WORD_LEN) so the band is never the weaker player.

rename_examples.note: Protocol §5 option B (new word, same mark): words validated to spell the same dot-count arc as this mark. Arc-validated only — legal screening per plan §1 required before adoption. Manage with tools/rename_check.py: 'python tools/rename_check.py <word>...' checks a candidate against the arc, '-a' adds spec-validated words.

attention_patterns.note: Two short ticks — something just arrived for you. This is the tail of the name-mark prefix on every unprompted message.
Three even ticks — a scheduled task fired. Plan §4 flow 4: at 9 pm a triple pulse arrives unprompted, then the message.
One sustained buzz — something failed and needs you. Deliberately unlike any braille cell so it cuts through playback.
Four ticks swelling in length — the device is waking up and reaching the relay. Plays at boot and on reconnect; never during playback.
Lub-dub — the device is alive and on the relay. Configurable and off by default (plan §4): an occasional pulse, not a metronome.
